settings.label: WhatsApp number
settings.info: With country code, digits only (e.g. 971501234567). Used by the WhatsApp float and concierge.

settings.content: The first-order discount shown above the footer. A theme cannot create a discount, so the code below must exist in Shopify admin › Discounts: a discount code, percentage off the order, customer eligibility set to customers with an account, and "limit to one use per customer" ticked. The theme puts the code on the bag; Shopify decides who may keep it.

settings.label: Discount code
settings.info: Must match the code in Shopify admin › Discounts exactly. Case does not matter.

settings.label: Percentage shown in the copy
settings.info: Digits only. This is wording, not the discount itself — change the real amount on the discount in admin and keep the two in step.
